div.head: ECf retr Rb XXX
div.ab: De animalibus, de equis uel aliis rebus inuentis quid faciendum sit.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 671 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page; the words in bold are the Retractator’s changes to ECf, as Liebermann prints them.

This is one of the chapter headings (rubrics) that a later writer, whom Liebermann calls “Rubricator II” and dates 1163–1189, made for the Retractator’s text. Liebermann prints them on pp. 670–672 as an appendix (Anhang) to ECf retr; they are numbered here “Rb” with his Roman numerals. He prints in small type what is taken from the text of ECf retr, so the words in bold are the Rubricator’s own.
Liebermann gives in the margin, in square brackets, the chapter of ECf retr that this heading belongs to: 24.
